instruction: Candid athletic photograph, eye-level medium shot. On an outdoor reddish track with green grass behind, the man in the black t-shirt (R1) on the left and the woman in the black and gray long-sleeve top (R2) on the right perform forearm planks facing each other. The man (R1) extends his left arm to high-five the woman (R2), who extends her right arm to meet his hand in the center. Both look at each other with focused, friendly expressions. Bright direct sunlight casts sharp shadows on the track.
elements: R1 extends his left arm toward R2 for the high-five
R2 extends her right arm to meet R1's hand in the center
R1 and R2 perform forearm planks facing each other during the hand contact
R2 meets R1's reaching hand while remaining in the facing plank position
outdoor reddish track with green grass behind
